## Foods & dishes
- [[WorldCuisines]]: 3 dishes, none Gambia-only; [[World Wide Dishes]]: 1 Wolof dish (benachin) shared with Senegal.

## Ingredients & food composition
- No national FCT is in the vault. The [[FAO INFOODS global databases]] candidate (priority 2, directory of 308 tables) includes the FAO/INFOODS **West African Food Composition Table (WAFCT)**, a regional table for the ECOWAS countries including Gambia; processing it is the most direct way to get local foods (fonio, cowpea, shea, baobab, leafy sauces). Until then, use [[USDA FoodData Central]] by name matching.
- [[CMAUP]]: 68 plants.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]]: 13 ethnobotany records (8 taxa).
- [[Exposome-Explorer]]: 1 biomarker–intake correlation from a Gambian study.
- [[KNApSAcK Family]] lists Gambia on its World map, but African flag pages were not scraped (counts unknown).
- Compound → effect chains come from the global backbone via [[Global]] ([[FooDB]], [[CTD]], [[Phenol-Explorer]], [[SpiceRx]], [[DDID]] for food–drug interactions).

## Gaps
- Almost no Gambian food data; WAFCT not yet processed.
